content.text:
**Finding: deviation (high severity) — § 12.4 non-compete on Customer**

§ 12.4 imposes a 24-month post-term, worldwide, all-products non-compete on Meridian, expressly extending to *acquiring* competing products. This is walk-away territory: the duration exceeds 12 months post-term, the scope is undefined ("any product or service that competes with Vendor"), and there are no carve-outs for internal development or acquisitions — so it fails the fallback on every material term. It also flatly contradicts § 12.3, where Copperleaf acknowledges we have made no non-compete commitment.

Redline validated (ok:true) and finding submitted: delete § 12.4, leaving § 12.3 to govern, with an offer to discuss a term-only restriction on a named competing product if Copperleaf needs protection.
